units: <cite ref="Berakhot 40a:1">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>אסור … עד שיתן מ׳ לבהמתו</he> a person is forbidden to eat before giving food to his animal.

<cite ref="Taanit 20a">Taan. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ אדם</he> food fit for human beings; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:7:3">Y. Ḥag. II, end, 78ᶜ</cite> <he>אפי׳ מ׳ אפי׳ כסות</he>, read: <he>אפי׳ מובל אפי׳ כפות</he>, v. <cite ref="J00048"><he>יָבַל</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>מַאֲכָלוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:5">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>שתהא אוכל מ׳ כאדם</he> that thou shouldst eat food like human beings; (<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 4:17">Tosef. Sot. IV, 17</cite> <he>מעדנים</he>, Var. <he>מאכל אדם</he>).
